name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: SaaS Account Executive | Consultative Selling, Executive Stakeholders & Hands-On AI Agent Expertise
summary: Quota-carrying SaaS account executive who also builds and deploys AI agents hands-on. Ranked top three in sales at Accelo on a team that grew from 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled, earning into accelerator tiers and closing $20K+ deals with C-suite buyers. Held 120% of sales targets at Wix and closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K at Fetch & Funnel. At Solenzo, architects agentic AI systems for clients, breaking manual workflows into agent logic and translating business intent into reliable LLM output, so the product conversation starts from real deployments, not slides. Denver based.

Translate non-technical stakeholders' goals into precise prompts and agent instructions, the bridge between business intent and reliable AI output.
Built rubric-based evaluation loops to grade AI output quality before it reaches a client, keeping deployments trustworthy.
